MustAct.description: Who must act next on a mission or run.

RunOutcomeStatus.description: Terminal outcome of a finished run.

AgentState.description: Desired/observed agent seat state. `suspended`: the seat was stopped at a quiet boundary and resumes its own native session; see `suspension`.

AgentReachability.description: Whether the daemon can currently reach the agent runtime.

TimelineStatus.description: Run status reported in a timeline `status` entry.

ErrorCode.description: Versioned safe error code; unknown codes fall back to `retryable`.

ratio.description: First child share; absent means 0.5. Requires glasses capability version 2.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant; servers emit millisecond precision with `Z`.

Revision.description: Opaque per-subject revision; compare for equality, echo in fences.

Snapshot.description: The complete projected state at one local store index and projection version.

machine_version.description: Compile-time build identity of the responding daemon; absent on older servers.

Operational.description: Whether a projected resource belongs to current operational state or retained history, and which live identity makes it actionable.

request.description: A person-step ask's structured request; absent on a free-text ask.

update.description: Information the person asked for. It asks nothing: reading it (work.done with answer id read) clears it.

data.description: Base64 of up to 512 KiB starting at offset.

Mission.description: A mission: a reusable definition plus its runs.

outcome.description: The outcome a person or an authorized agent set after the run finished.

steps.description: The run's steps: for an open run or a mission's latest run, and for every run in a mission detail read.

mission_id.description: The mission this work's run belongs to.

person_answers.description: Responses to the asks this attempt made, or a person ask's own response.

blocked_on.description: Current incarnation's harness blocking axis; human means a person must answer before it continues.

ask.description: Structured human ask kind (question, permission, or review); meaningful only while blocked_on is human.

reason.description: Diagnostic harness reason, not a machine-readable verdict.

fault.description: Current member reconcile failure; cleared by a successful pass.

todo.description: Latest accepted harness todo snapshot and claim provenance; null if none was observed. Stale observations remain visible.

current_work.description: current_work_ids named for display, in the same order.

delivery.description: Whether the process that carries this local seat's messages is live and runs this daemon's st binary. Present for local native seats that are running or waiting, including human-blocked harnesses; a stale path makes a running agent `waiting`.

subagents.description: The subagents this seat's harness runs now, oldest first: recorded, not ended, with a lease that runs past this read. An older daemon omits the field.

rollout.description: Durable owned-seat cutover, incarnation and native-session fences, phase, deadline and blockers. Omitted by older daemons.

suspension.description: The seat's latest suspend or resume and its phase. An older daemon omits the field.

phase.description: suspend: quiescing, snapshotting, suspended, or failed (refused; the seat keeps running). resume: restoring, verifying, resumed; a failed resume returns to suspended with code and reason.

operation_id.description: The request claim; each phase change is a change of this agent.

native_session_id.description: The harness's own session the seat suspended on and resumes.

incarnation_id.description: The suspended incarnation, or the one a completed resume launched.

code.description: Stable reason the last suspend or resume failed, such as not-quiescent, native-session-mismatch or native-resume-unavailable.

blocking.description: Why a refused suspend did not find the seat quiet, such as turn-in-flight, pending-ask, unsent-input, claimed-work or subagent-running.

id.description: The harness's own subagent ID, unique within its seat.

session_id.description: The harness session the subagent runs in.

work_id.description: The step the seat held when the subagent appeared.

TimelineEntry.description: One conversation timeline entry. `replace` keeps id, sequence, role and type; `finalize` makes it immutable.

Fence.description: The snapshot and exact mutable identities the user acted on; echoed byte-identically in actions.

StructuredRequest.description: A typed question with named answers. A decision names one accept, one decline and at most one request_changes answer; a choice names 2 to 5 options; feedback asks for text.

why_person.description: Why only this person can answer.

custom.description: A choice also takes an answer in the person's own words.

PersonUpdate.description: Information an agent brings a person who asked for it. Nothing waits on it.

about.description: Where the person asked: their mission run or step run, or their message to the agent.

revision.description: The revision the question is about, such as a reviewed head.

consequence.description: What happens next when the person gives this answer.

outcome.description: Required on a decision answer; absent on a choice option.

PersonAnswerInput.description: A named answer id for a decision or choice; text for feedback, a custom choice, or the changes requested.

wrapped.description: Whether this line continues onto the next terminal row through automatic wrapping.

cells.description: Number of terminal display cells occupied by the run, which may differ from its text length.

strikethrough.description: Present when the run uses strikethrough styling.

uri.description: Hyperlink destination emitted by the terminal.

kitty_keyboard.description: Active Kitty keyboard protocol enhancement flags as a bitmask.

revision.description: Digest of the rest of the screen: equal revisions mean equal screens.

next_sequence.description: Fence for the next input or resize.
